LEGAL NOTICE

Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 08, 2026

This Privacy Policy describes Our policies and procedures on the collection, use, and disclosure of Your information when You use the Service and tells You about Your privacy rights and how the law protects You.

We use Your Personal Data to provide and improve the Service. We collect, use, and disclose Your information as described here and, where required by law, only where We have a valid legal basis, including Your consent where required. This policy was created with help from the Privacy Policy Generator.

Interpretation and Definitions

Capitalized words have the meanings below, whether singular or plural.

  • Account means a unique account created for You to access Our Service or parts of it.
  • Affiliate means an entity that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a party, where control means ownership of 50% or more of voting shares, equity, or securities.
  • Company (also “We,” “Us,” or “Our”) refers to Invoice Next.
  • Cookies are small files placed on Your computer, mobile device, or other device by a website.
  • Country/State refers to Pakistan.
  • Device means any device that can access the Service, such as a computer, phone, or tablet.
  • Personal Data or Personal Information means information relating to an identified or identifiable individual. We use these terms interchangeably unless a law uses a specific term.
  • Service refers to the Website.
  • Service Provider means a person or company that processes data for the Company or helps provide, support, or analyze the Service.
  • Usage Data means data collected automatically from use of the Service or its infrastructure.
  • User means any individual who accesses or uses the Service.
  • Website refers to Invoice Next at https://invonxt.com/.
  • You means the individual using the Service, or the company or legal entity on whose behalf that individual acts.

Collecting and Using Your Personal Information

Personal Data

We may ask for information that can identify or contact You, including:

  • Email address
  • First and last name
  • Phone number
  • Address, State, Province, ZIP/Postal code, and City

Usage Data

Usage Data is collected automatically and may include IP address, browser type and version, pages visited, visit time, time spent, unique device identifiers, and diagnostic data. On mobile it may also include device type, unique ID, operating system, and mobile browser. We may collect information sent by Your browser.

Tracking Technologies and Cookies

We use Cookies and similar technologies to track activity and improve the Service. Browser Cookies help provide features; Web Beacons help count visits, measure popularity, and verify system integrity. You may refuse Cookies, although parts of the Service may then be unavailable.

Session Cookies are deleted when You close Your browser; Persistent Cookies remain after You go offline. Where required by law, non-essential Cookies are used only with consent. You may change or withdraw consent using Our cookie preferences tool, if available, or browser/device settings.

  • Necessary / Essential Cookies — Session Cookies administered by Us to authenticate users, prevent fraudulent use, and provide requested features.
  • Cookies Policy / Notice Acceptance Cookies — Persistent Cookies administered by Us to remember Your consent choices.
  • Functionality Cookies — Persistent Cookies administered by Us to remember choices such as login details and language preferences.

Use and Sharing of Your Personal Data

We may use Personal Data to provide and maintain the Service; manage Your Account; perform contracts; contact You by email, telephone, SMS, push notification, or similar means; manage requests; evaluate business transfers; analyze trends and campaigns; and improve Our Service, products, marketing, and Your experience.

Where permitted by law, We may send news and offers about similar services. Where prior consent is required, including under applicable EEA and UK law, We send marketing only with consent. You may unsubscribe through an email link or by contacting Us.

We may share Personal Data with Service Providers; during business transfers; with Affiliates required to honor this Policy; with other users when You post publicly; or for another purpose with Your consent.

Text Messages Privacy Notice

If You opt in to SMS, We collect Your phone number, the date and method of consent, and message delivery and read information. No mobile information is shared with or sold to third parties or Affiliates for marketing or promotion. Phone numbers and consent records are shared only with Service Providers that must handle them to deliver texts.

SMS consent is not a condition of purchase or use. Messages may concern customer support, account notices, deliveries, authentication codes, security alerts, or marketing offers. Reply STOP to opt out or HELP for support. Message and data rates may apply; frequency varies; carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

Retention of Your Personal Data

We retain Personal Data only as long as necessary for the stated purposes, legal obligations, disputes, and enforcement. These are maximum periods, and We may delete or anonymize sooner:

  • User Accounts: for the Account relationship plus up to 24 months after closure.
  • Support tickets and correspondence: up to 24 months after ticket closure.
  • Chat transcripts: up to 24 months for quality assurance and staff training.
  • Website analytics data: up to 24 months from collection.
  • Server logs: up to 24 months for security and troubleshooting.

Data may be kept longer for security, fraud prevention, legal compliance or claims, Your explicit request, or routine backup schedules. When periods expire, We securely delete or anonymize data. Residual encrypted backups may remain for a limited period and are restored only for security, disaster recovery, or legal compliance. Anonymous statistical data may be retained indefinitely.

Transfer of Your Personal Data

Your information may be processed wherever the Company and its processing partners operate, including jurisdictions with different laws. Where required, We use appropriate safeguards and supplementary measures. We take reasonably necessary steps to treat data securely and will not transfer it without adequate controls.

Delete Your Personal Data

You may delete or ask Us to help delete Personal Data We collected. You may update, amend, or delete information through Account settings, if available, or contact Us to request access, correction, or deletion. We may retain information where a legal obligation or lawful basis requires it.

Disclosure of Your Personal Data

Business Transactions

If the Company is involved in a merger, acquisition, or asset sale, Personal Data may be transferred. We will notify You before it becomes subject to a different Privacy Policy.

Law Enforcement and Other Legal Requirements

We may disclose Personal Data when required by law, in response to valid public-authority requests, or in good faith to comply with an obligation; protect Company rights or property; investigate wrongdoing; protect Users or the public; or protect against legal liability.

Security of Your Personal Data

No Internet transmission or electronic storage method is completely secure. Although We use commercially reasonable means to protect Personal Data, We cannot guarantee absolute security.

Detailed Information on Processing

Service Providers may access Personal Data and process Service activity under their privacy policies.

  • Mouseflow — session replay and heatmaps operated by Mouseflow ApS. Privacy Policy.
  • FreshDesk — customer-support software operated by Freshworks, Inc. Privacy Policy.
  • Google Places — place information operated by Google that may collect information from You and Your Device for security. Privacy Policy.

Children’s and Minors’ Privacy

The Service is not directed to, and We do not knowingly collect Personal Information from, anyone under 16. Parents or guardians who believe a child provided information should contact Us. If We learn that We collected such information, We will remove it as soon as reasonably possible. Where law sets a higher consent age, We may require parental or guardian consent.

Links to Other Websites

Our Service may link to websites not operated by Us. Review each third party’s Privacy Policy. We have no control over and assume no responsibility for third-party content, policies, or practices.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Policy. We will post the new Policy here, update the “Last updated” date, and notify You by email and/or a prominent Service notice before a change becomes effective. Changes are effective when posted.
